entities.summary: Gerardo Murillo Coronado, also known by his signature "Dr. Atl", was a Mexican painter, writer and intellectual. He is most famous for his works inspired by the Mexican landscape, particularly volcanoes, and for being one of the early figures of modern Mexican art.
